timeouts.intro: The supervisor checks every speaking agent once a second and colours it by how long it has been silent.
timeouts.stallHint: Silence for this long turns an agent orange. Informational only — nothing is interrupted.
timeouts.hardHint: Silence for this long aborts the turn, marks the message skipped and lets the round continue without it.
timeouts.toolHint: Budget for a single MCP tool call. Used from the step that adds tools.
timeouts.perChat: A chat can override the hard timeout in its own group settings; these values apply everywhere else.
timeouts.legendWorking: Requesting, streaming or running a tool
timeouts.legendAway: Working, but silent for longer than the stall timeout
timeouts.legendOffline: Timed out, failing repeatedly, or its provider does not answer
